origin_narratives.summary: Current practitioner material defines Magha Shraddha through Magha Nakshatra prevailing during Pitru Paksha aparahna. If Magha occupies part of aparahna on two days, the longer overlap selects the day; if Magha and Trayodashi both prevail then the source names a Magha Trayodashi case. The 2027 New Delhi list happens to place Magha Shraddha beside Dwadashi on 27 September. Dwadashi is not the defining rule, and another city or year may resolve differently. origin_narratives.title: Nachiketa asks Yama what follows death
origin_narratives.summary: In Max Muller's 1884 Katha Upanishad, Vajasravasa gives worn-out cows in sacrifice. His young son Nachiketa repeatedly asks to whom he will be given; in anger his father says, ‘to Death.’ Nachiketa reaches Yama's abode and waits three nights while Yama is absent. Yama returns and offers three boons in recompense. Nachiketa first asks that his father become calm, recognise him and welcome him without anger. Yama grants it. For the second boon Nachiketa asks for the fire teaching associated in the text with heaven; Yama teaches it and names it for him. For the third boon Nachiketa asks what happens after death, noting that people disagree. Yama offers long life, descendants, wealth, power, music and pleasure instead, but Nachiketa refuses what is temporary. Yama distinguishes the good from the merely pleasant and teaches about Self, knowledge, discipline and death; the text closes by saying Nachiketa received the knowledge and attained its goal. The child danger, three-night wait, reconciliation and fire are narrative events, not actions to copy. This story is not Magha Shraddha's origin or Shraddha vidhi, proves no afterlife fact, carries no ancestor message and cannot compel reconciliation with an unsafe parent.

origin_narratives.title: Nachiketa Yama से death के बाद का प्रश्न पूछते हैं
origin_narratives.summary: Max Muller की 1884 Katha Upanishad में Vajasravasa यज्ञ में बूढ़ी और थकी गायें देते हैं। उनके छोटे पुत्र Nachiketa बार-बार पूछते हैं कि उन्हें किसे दिया जाएगा; क्रोध में पिता कहते हैं, ‘Death को।’ Nachiketa Yama के घर पहुँचते हैं और Yama की अनुपस्थिति में तीन रात प्रतीक्षा करते हैं। लौटकर Yama इसकी भरपाई के लिए तीन वर देते हैं। पहले वर में Nachiketa चाहते हैं कि पिता शांत हों, उन्हें पहचानें और बिना क्रोध स्वीकार करें; Yama यह देते हैं। दूसरे वर में वे heaven से जुड़ी fire teaching पूछते हैं; Yama उसे सिखाकर उनके नाम से जोड़ते हैं। तीसरे वर में Nachiketa मृत्यु के बाद क्या होता है पूछते हैं और मानते हैं कि लोग असहमत हैं। Yama बदले में लंबी आयु, संतान, धन, शक्ति, संगीत और सुख देते हैं, पर Nachiketa अस्थायी चीजें ठुकराते हैं। तब Yama good और merely pleasant का भेद तथा Self, knowledge, discipline और death की शिक्षा देते हैं; पाठ कहता है कि Nachiketa ने यह ज्ञान पाकर उसका लक्ष्य पाया। Child danger, तीन रात की waiting, reconciliation और fire केवल narrative events हैं, copy करने की actions नहीं। यह Magha Shraddha की origin story या vidhi नहीं, afterlife proof या ancestor message नहीं, और unsafe parent से reconciliation बाध्य नहीं करती।

steps.instruction: Food, medicine, water, fire, animal, crowd, travel, accessibility, child/dependent, privacy और cost conditions देखें; unsafe हो तो decline/leave करें।
steps.why: Participation care, law या consent से ऊपर नहीं।

steps.instruction: Law, health, consent और budget में directions मानें; permission बिना lead, film, touch, restricted water/space entry, animal feeding, food disposal या home-copy न करें।
steps.why: Participation officiation/transmission authority नहीं।

steps.instruction: All-sons duty, unknown-date coverage, merit, satisfaction, Vishnu-loka, health, wealth, marriage, progeny, fertility, lineage और Pitru-Dosha removal को attributed claims मानें, Devam facts/guarantees नहीं।
steps.why: Living-practice claims labelled और bounded रहते हैं।

steps.instruction: Authority की safe closing लें, belongings लें, eat/hydrate/medicine करें और omen, donation pressure, reconciliation pressure या future obligation बिना निकलें।
steps.why: Participant route ordinary care और free consent में खत्म होता है।

closing.text: Named authority की safe closing लें, फिर prediction, debt, copied procedure या pressure बिना ordinary care पर लौटें।
closing.scope_note: केवल participant guidance। Current family, priest, sampradaya, Gaya/ghat, temple या institution applicability, performer, timing, sequence, materials और closing की owner है।

variants.difference: Language, spelling, dress, ordinary food preference, photograph/no-photograph, familiar prayer और silence minor हैं; ये state procedures नहीं बनाते।

variants.scope: Known/unknown death date and missed-rite applicability
variants.difference: Named authority तय करे unknown-date या missed-rite context लागू है; calendar नहीं।

variants.scope: Performer eligibility and attributed all-sons statement
variants.difference: Hemadri attribution generic policy नहीं; gender, kinship, residence, sequence और responsibility को named owner चाहिए।

variants.scope: Magha Nakshatra with Trayodashi in aparahna
variants.difference: Source इस overlap को distinct name देती है; local timing और formal action अलग resolve हों।

variants.scope: Dwadashi, Maha Bharani, Sarva Pitru and other Shraddha days
variants.difference: Shared civil date या ancestor theme इनके tithi, Nakshatra या Amavasya rules merge नहीं करती।

variants.scope: Named Gaya, ghat, river, temple, priest, sampradaya or institution
variants.difference: Timing, access, water, crowd, performer, materials, payment, permission और closing current owner के हैं।

variants.scope: Grief, abuse, estrangement, lineage, child/dependent, health, water, fire, crowd, privacy, accessibility or cost needs
variants.difference: Safety और consent participation बदल/रोक सकते हैं और ritual completion से ऊपर हैं।

safety_and_boundaries: Fast, dehydration, medicine change, bath, river/ghat entry, fire, smoke, crowd, travel, animal feeding, food disposal, donation, recitation, purchase या priest payment required नहीं।
कोई child/dependent Nachiketa का departure, danger, waiting, abusive command, unsafe reconciliation या fire copy न करे; guardian safety completion से ऊपर है।
किसी पर forgiveness, positive memory, family disclosure, belief, photograph, touch, public grief, gotra claim या unsafe-relative contact owed नहीं।
Dreams, birds, animals, food, water, flame, coincidences और feelings ancestor messages नहीं।
Pitru Dosha diagnose न करें; satisfaction, liberation, Vishnu-loka, merit, health, longevity, wealth, marriage, progeny, fertility, lineage repair, prosperity, peace या reunion promise न करें।
Gender, kinship, marriage, fertility, adoption, lineage, residence या participation status पर shame/duty assign न करें।
Formal materials/actions यहाँ reconstruct नहीं होते; named current authority लें या private remembrance रखें।
Immediate danger में 112; medical, water, fire, animal, food, safeguarding, venue और legal rules completion से ऊपर हैं।
Authored का अर्थ केवल यह lane है, projected, hosted, independently released या published नहीं।

open_gaps: Not projected, hosted or published; formal Magha Shraddha, Magha Trayodashi and named Gaya/ghat/institution procedures remain separate owner lanes.
